Every entry was fetched live and verified to resolve, and to return that
company's real postings, before being listed. Slugs that resolve but serve
a different company or Personio demo data are listed under _rejected.
Copy to config/boards.json, edit, then: node scripts/seed-boards.ts config/boards.json

read; they are listed so nobody re-adds them from a green probe alone:
personio:personio-gmbh -- Personio demo tenants. All serve the same three
smartrecruiters:robertbosch -- Bosch sandbox tenant, 6 rows, titles like
'test consent new'. The real board is smartrecruiters:BoschGroup.
smartrecruiters:haufe-lexware -- 3 stale rows; real board is HaufeGroup.
ashby:eon -- Eon, a US laser-comms company in Culver City, not E.ON SE.
ashby:vector -- a US remote-first startup, not Vector Informatik.
ashby:quantum -- a UK London/Maidstone company, not Quantum-Systems.
lever:zeiss -- abandoned test board, rows named '323232' in San Francisco.
greenhouse:mhp -- MHP AS of Cheyenne WY, not MHP (a Porsche company).
_not_reachable: From the supplied list, these could NOT be reached by any adapter and are
not included. Most run on Workday or SAP SuccessFactors, which have no
public unauthenticated board API, or on fully custom career sites. Every
slug variant of the company name was probed against Greenhouse, Lever,
Ashby, SmartRecruiters and Personio before giving up.

Most of these still surface through the Bundesagentur searches above, which
index employers regardless of which ATS they run - that is why the search
list was widened to Stuttgart, Karlsruhe, Mannheim, Heidelberg, Ulm,
Friedrichshafen, Freiburg, Frankfurt, Darmstadt, Mainz, Ludwigshafen,
Wiesbaden and Saarbruecken along with the new companies.
Job portals (Workingstudentjobs.de, LinkedIn, StepStone, EnglishJobs,
Hochschuljobboerse, KIT job board, Indeed) are search aggregators with no
public JSON API. They would need the opt-in browser adapter, which is
disabled by default and has never been live-tested; and a search page is a
ranked slice, not a snapshot, so absence from it is not a close event. The
Bundesagentur adapter is the supported aggregator - it is a real API and
already indexes most of what those portals resell.
